display.title: Starting the Day Right, Part 3: Make Your Bed and Tidy Your Room
display.summary_short: After Shiviti, Modeh Ani and negel vasser comes the next step: make your bed, put away your things and help Mommy, as part of honoring your parents.
display.summary_long: The third talk in Uncle Yossi's series on starting the day the Jewish way. He reviews the first steps: look at your Shiviti sign and remember Hashem is there, say Modeh Ani, and wash negel vasser. Then, after getting dressed, before running to the breakfast table, ask yourself: did I put away my pajamas and straighten my blanket and pillow? Is anything lying on the floor that someone could trip over? Don't leave it for Mommy, who has plenty to do already. Keeping your toys, games and things neat is part of kibbud av va'em, doing your share at home, and Hashem will bless you with everything good.
display.lesson: Do your share at home: keep your room and your things neat so you help your parents and keep everyone safe.
